entities.title: Burrows
entities.summary: Whatever the seed, a burrow the game can be played on, checked over 300 seeds.
criteria: The same seed digs the same burrow, and different seeds dig different ones
Every burrow is a mirror image of itself, left to right
Every tunnel can be reached from where the puffin starts, and none is a dead end
The den is three tiles shut in by turf with one door above it, which the puffin cannot get through
One tunnel runs off both sides of the island and comes back on the other; the rest of the edge is turf
Tunnels are one tile wide
Four feathers, one in each quarter, and a sand eel on every other tunnel tile but the puffin's own

entities.title: The puffin, the phases and the same game twice
entities.summary: A game waits, counts in and plays; the puffin moves as pointed; pause stops everything; a seed and its controls replay exactly.
criteria: A game waits on the title screen, counts in, and then plays, with the fox out and the others in the den
The puffin stands until it is pointed somewhere, then runs a tile every ten steps and eats what it finds
It turns where the player last pointed as soon as there is a tunnel that way, turns round on the spot between tiles, and stops at turf
The tunnel off one side of the island comes back on the other
The same seed and the same controls give the same game; another seed gives another burrow
Pause stops everything, the frame count included, until it is pressed again

entities.title: The hunters
entities.summary: Hunters keep to the tunnels and leave the den in turn; the mink, the fox and the raven each hunt in their own way.
criteria: Hunters stay on tiles they may walk, leave the den in the order fox, mink, skua, raven, and never turn back on their own
The mink takes the shortest way to the puffin and catches one that stands still, in the time its speed allows
The fox follows the puffin's trail round the den where the mink, from the same tile, takes the short way
The raven dives when it sees the puffin down a straight tunnel, and is faster by the dive's bonus

notChecked: The skua's way to the puffin's next meal has no test of its own.
Hunting and prowling in turn, and how long each lasts.
The raven's rest between dives, and that a scent older than eight seconds is not followed.

entities.title: Feathers and routs
entities.summary: A feather mobs the hunters that are out; the puffin routs the ones it touches; they go home, rest and come back; the terns leave.
criteria: A feather mobs the hunters out in the tunnels and leaves one in the den alone
Touching mobbed hunters routs them, for 250 and then 500, without costing a puffin
A routed hunter reaches the middle of the den, rests, and comes out again
When the terns' time runs out, mobbed hunters are out again
A mobbed hunter gets farther from the puffin

checks.symbol: a feather brings the terns: hunters out in the tunnels turn tail, and the puffin routs the ones it touches
when the terns leave, mobbed hunters hunt again
a mobbed hunter runs away from the puffin

notChecked: The third and fourth rout under one feather (750 and 1,000).
A second feather while the terns are still out.

entities.title: Lives, burrows, scoring and the demo
entities.summary: A caught puffin costs a life and three end the game; a cleared burrow brings a bonus and a new, harder burrow; an extra puffin comes at 4,000; the demo plays itself.
criteria: A caught puffin costs a life, the eels stay eaten, and the third ends the game, which then returns to the title screen with the best score raised
Eating every eel clears the burrow: two treats were shown, the score is the eels, feathers and treats and the clean bonus, and a different burrow follows as level 2
On level 2 hunters are faster, the terns stay less long, prowls are shorter and the raven waits less
An extra puffin comes at 4,000 points, and never more than five are held
A demo plays by itself to its end, leaves the best score alone, and gives way to a real game on a start press
